title: FREE Unlimited AI Voices | Better Than ElevenLabs (Microsoft Banned It)

bestTimestamp.label: Accessing the VibeVoice repository
bestTimestamp.rationale: This timestamp marks the beginning of the crucial information on how to obtain the 'banned' VibeVoice repository, which is the core subject and value proposition of the video.

insights.title: VibeVoice Banned by Microsoft
insights.description: Microsoft's VibeVoice, an open-source voice generation tool, was briefly removed due to concerns about its highly realistic voice output and potential for deep fakes.

insights.title: Local Installation for Free AI Voices
insights.description: The video shows how to access a community-saved version of VibeVoice to run locally, offering free and unlimited AI voice generation without subscription fees, unlike services like ElevenLabs.

insights.title: Multi-speaker and Multilingual Capabilities
insights.description: VibeVoice supports generating audio with multiple speakers and in various languages, enabling the creation of AI podcasts and multilingual content.

insights.title: Voice Cloning Feature
insights.description: The tutorial details how to clone your own voice using a 30-second audio sample, achieving highly realistic AI voice replication.

chapters.name: VibeVoice: Microsoft's Banned AI Voice Tool
chapters.description: Microsoft released and then quickly pulled VibeVoice due to its highly realistic voice generation and concerns about deep fakes. Community members, however, preserved the code.

chapters.name: Accessing the VibeVoice Repository
chapters.description: This section explains how to obtain the preserved VibeVoice GitHub repository to clone voices and generate AI audio locally, avoiding subscription fees.

chapters.name: Multi-Speaker & Customization
chapters.description: VibeVoice allows for multiple speakers in audio generation, enabling the creation of AI podcasts with customizable voices.

chapters.name: VibeVoice vs. Paid Alternatives
chapters.description: The video showcases the quality of VibeVoice's generated audio, asserting it is comparable to, if not better than, paid subscriptions like ElevenLabs.

chapters.name: Installing VibeVoice
chapters.description: This segment guides on installing a specific community-maintained version of the VibeVoice repository using Claude Code to ensure text-to-speech functionality.

chapters.name: Testing VibeVoice with Pre-loaded Voices
chapters.description: The presenter demonstrates spinning up a local server to test VibeVoice, showing how to select speakers, choose from pre-loaded voices, and generate audio samples.

chapters.name: Multilingual and Podcasting Features
chapters.description: VibeVoice's capabilities extend to generating audio in multiple languages and creating podcast episodes with different speakers, showcasing its versatility.

chapters.name: Voice Cloning Your Own Voice
chapters.description: A detailed walkthrough on how to clone your own voice using a 30-second audio clip, convert it to the correct format, and integrate it into VibeVoice.

chapters.name: Testing the Cloned Voice
chapters.description: The video concludes by testing the newly cloned voice, demonstrating its realism and comparing it favorably to professional paid voice models.

chapters.name: Conclusion and Resources
chapters.description: The presenter wraps up, encouraging viewers to like and subscribe, and offers a free course on building AI agents, along with providing all necessary installation instructions and prompts.
